names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Memnon, făcătorul de minuni».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Μέμνων ο Θαυματουργός», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 29. април ст. ст., „Преп. Мемнон чудотворац.“ Преп. is the `venerable` and чудотворац the `wonderworker` this folder already carries in `types`, both of which `honorific.js` composes back; the heading gives no house and no country, so the bare forename is the whole of the Serbian form. One other folder holds the same bare spelling in Russian; the fold was measured and the row is in the batch's commit message.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1515, «Мемнон Чудотворец, Египетский, игумен», with TWO RANK WORDS TAKEN OFF and not one: «игумен», abbot, after the second comma, and «Чудотворец», wonderworker, which BRIEF-RUSSIAN §6 lists among the rank words and which this folder already carries in `types`. What is left is the forename and the toponymic, «Мемнон Египетский». The day's own line declines him «Мемнона чудотворца» and gives no toponymic at all. The bare «Мемнон» is a fold two folders wide in this corpus, which is why the toponymic is kept: measured against the gate's own key function, 'египетскии мемнон' has no other holder.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Мемнона чудотворца (II).»

attestations.note: The day's second entry of eight. ITS CENTURY AGREES WITH THE FOLDER'S: the line heads him «(II)» and the folder's existing second-century death came off the Ohrid Prologue, so nothing moved. WHAT THIS SOURCE GIVES THAT THE OTHERS DID NOT IS THE COUNTRY AND THE OFFICE: doxologia's life says expressly that it names no year, no country and no monastery, and this calendar's life page life952 opens «Преподобный Мемнон Чудотворец с юности подвизался в Египетской пустыне» and makes him abbot of one of the Egyptian monasteries — which is where the ru name form's «Египетский» comes from and which the folder's existing `abbot` already said. THE MONASTERY IS STILL NOT NAMED, by this source either. NO `locations` WERE WRITTEN: the Egyptian desert is not a point. The day page prints no hymn under his name — its four hymns are two for the nine martyrs of Cyzicus and two for the bishop of Ostrog — and the folder's existing troparion is not Russian and was left as it stands.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 29 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Memnon, făcătorul de minuni»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Μέμνων ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», **a day earlier than the 29 April the Romanian row on this folder already carries**, and it is plainly the same man: «Όσιος Μέμνων ο Θαυματουργός», a monk from his youth who subjected the flesh to the spirit, was granted the gift of wonderworking, drove locust swarms off the villagers' fields by his prayer, and became abbot of his monastery. The Greek adds two things the Romanian life did not have — that whenever the farming people of his district fell into great straits he brought them help out of the monastery's savings, and that he went to other cities collecting contributions with which he made up the relief of the suffering — and it has men, women and children running to follow his funeral with the warmest tears. **It also records a second day, and it is a day this corpus already keeps for a second Memnon**: «Σε μερικούς συναξαριστές η μνήμη του Οσίου επαναλαμβάνεται και στις 19 Μαΐου» — in some synaxaristes his memory is repeated on 19 May — which is the day of the corpus's `memnon-the-venerable-19-may`, a folder the Romanian pass made from doxologia's «Sfântul Cuvios Memnon» for 19 mai. Whether those two folders are one man is a question for the writer and is named in the reader's report; nothing is moved or merged here, and 28 April is the day this row records. The page gives no year, no country and no monastery by name, so the empty `dates` were left empty. **It prints no apolytikion and no kontakion**: the one hymn on the page is headed «Κάθισμα», a kathisma in Ἦχος πλ. δ΄ to the model «Τὴν Σοφίαν καὶ Λόγον», which is neither of the two kinds this corpus holds, so no hymn was taken.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.05.2026 (29. април ст. ст.) — „Преп. Мемнон чудотворац.“

attestations.note: The same man, in four sentences: given from his youth to fasting and prayer, so cleansed that he became a dwelling of the Holy Spirit, healer of incurable sicknesses, and the one who appeared in storms at sea and saved ships from destruction. **A first date**: „Упокоји се мирно у Господу у II столећу“ → `death` 101–200, `display: "2nd century"`, `traditional`, where doxologia gives no year, no country and no monastery by name and saint.gr gives none either. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "2nd century"` reads «II в.» and «2ος αι.» The Serbian day is Julian 29 April, with the Romanian and against the Greek 28 April. The Prologue has none of doxologia's spring in the dry place, none of its locusts, and none of saint.gr's monastery savings carried to the farming people; the sea storms are the one wonder all three accounts share. It prints no hymn — saint.gr's one hymn for him is a kathisma, which this corpus does not hold, and was taken by neither reading.

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Memnon, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Memnon, făcătorul de minuni», Glasul 8

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst work the barren desert, and with sighs from the depths thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou becamest a light to the world, shining with wonders, Memnon our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls be saved.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 29. април ст. ст.: „Упокоји се мирно у Господу у II столећу, и пресели се у небеске дворе Господње.“ — the first century any calendar read for this folder has given. doxologia's life says expressly that it gives no year, no country and no monastery by name, and saint.gr's notice gives no year either.
